messages:
Danielle: Heads up — we're shifting cutoff for 1.9.2 by 30m due to an unexpected dependency bump in image-builder. Need to coordinate late merges and a quick ladder for exceptions.

Rick: On it. What's the exact window? can we get an exception process?

Danielle: Cutoff now 17:30 PT (was 17:00). If you need a late merge, follow the merge-ladder: PR -> add QA label -> ops signoff -> tag me for final approval. We'll only accept bugfixes & version bumps.

Priya: @Danielle can you add the changelog owner? I have a short entry ready.

Danielle: Changelog owner: @Priya. Please add a brief entry under "1.9.2": "image-builder: updated tarball extraction to avoid path-traversal".

Josh: FYI my PR #5123 is a version bump for an internal lib. It touches runtime config; needs smoke test. @CI Bot can you run the smoke job on jenkins/job/infra-smoke? I'll link logs after.

CI Bot: CI Bot: queued smoke job for PR 5123 -> https://ci.internal/infra-smoke/9834. Status: queued

Priya: I'll take changelog and quick QA on PR 5123 once smoke passes. @Marco can you do a quick look at the runtime config diff? 2-line change.

Marco: Looking now. If it's just a flag rename, should be fine. If it's toggling a default, hold off until ops confirms.

Rick: Ops: any issues with an extra 30m runway? we might need to push the deployment window 45m.

Emily: We can extend to +45m but need rollback plan. Add a rollbackable tag to each late merge PR and include migration script revert steps in PR description.

Danielle: New rule: late merges must include 'rollback-instructions' in the PR body and a one-liner migration revert. Also add 'merge-ladder: ready-for-ops' label when ops approves. I'll update release notes and ping infra.

Priya: :thumbsup: I'll add changelog and mark PR 5123 with rollback steps. Smoke job failed on first run (timeout), CI retried.

CI Bot: CI Bot: smoke job 9834 -> running. previous failed due to timeout on vm-provision stage.

Josh: Re-running locally reproduced a flaky provisioning step. I'll add a retry wrapper in the smoke script: `set -e; for i in 1 2; do ./scripts/provision || true; done` — will push patch shortly.

Marco: Please don't leave `|| true` — that hides failures. Use retry with backoff: `for i in 1 3; do ./scripts/provision && break || sleep $((i*2)); done`

Josh: Good call. Pushed fix. PR now has smoke artifact link. @Danielle can we still accept under new ladder?

Danielle: Yes — marking PR 5123 as exception approved. @Rick schedule the extra 15m for rollout so total extension is 45m. Everyone, freeze other non-critical merges.

Rick: Scheduled: release window extended by 45m. Noted freeze. Thanks.

Priya: I'll finalize changelog entry & add release note blurb. Also adding 'post-deploy-checklist' items: health-check, latency spike watch, and key metrics dashboards.

Danielle: Perfect. After deploy, run `./scripts/postdeploy-checks.sh` and report in #incidents if anything odd. Thanks all.
